title: Truncate Text
content: Implement text truncation with show more/less toggle. CSS truncation: line-clamp-3 for multi-line, truncate for single line. JavaScript truncation: cut at character/word limit, add "...". Show more button: expands to full text, changes to "Show less". Word boundary: do not cut words in middle. Character count: show remaining characters. Animate: smooth height transition on expand/collapse. Read more link: inline "...read more" link. Handle HTML content: truncate safely without breaking tags. Preserve formatting: maintain paragraphs and line breaks when expanded.

variants.simple: Add text truncation with ellipsis and expand/collapse toggle.
variants.detailed: Implement text truncation with show more/less toggle. CSS truncation: line-clamp-3 for multi-line, truncate for single line. JavaScript truncation: cut at character/word limit, add "...". Show more button: expands to full text, changes to "Show less". Word boundary: do not cut words in middle. Character count: show remaining characters. Animate: smooth height transition on expand/collapse. Read more link: inline "...read more" link. Handle HTML content: truncate safely without breaking tags. Preserve formatting: maintain paragraphs and line breaks when expanded.
variants.advanced: Implement text truncation with expand/collapse and proper handling. CSS-only truncation: single line with truncate (text-overflow: ellipsis, overflow: hidden, white-space: nowrap), multi-line with line-clamp-N (display: -webkit-box, -webkit-line-clamp: N, -webkit-box-orient: vertical). JavaScript truncation: for dynamic control or server rendering. Word boundary: find last space before character limit, cut there to avoid mid-word truncation. Show more/less: button or link toggles between truncated and full, state tracked in useState. Inline "read more": "...read more" at end of truncated text, same element. Animation: CSS transition on max-height from truncated to scrollHeight, or use grid-template-rows trick for smooth height animation. Character/word count: optional display of remaining content ("...and 234 more characters"). HTML-safe truncation: if content has HTML, use DOM parser to truncate without breaking tags, or strip HTML first. Line counting: for precise line limits in JS, measure element height vs line-height, or use ResizeObserver. Preserve formatting: when expanded, maintain original paragraphs, line breaks, lists. Component API: <TruncatedText text={content} lines={3} showToggle /> or <TruncatedText maxLength={200} />. Accessibility: expanded state via aria-expanded on toggle, full text available to screen readers. Performance: virtualize very long content even when expanded.
